preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 2 * 10**5])
preconditions.description: Each test case has a node count n between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in [(int(stdin.readline()), [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for n, edges in [(int(stdin.readline()), [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)]) for _ in range(t)] for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(len(relabeling) == n for n, relabeling in zip([int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(set(relabeling) == set(range(1, n + 1)) for n, relabeling in zip([int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: The relabeling is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(any(winning_node(relabeling, n, edges) for winning_node in [lambda p, n, e: any(is_winning_position(p, n, e, start) for start in range(1, n + 1))]) for n, edges, relabeling in zip([int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)], [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n - 1) for n in [int(stdin.readline()) for _ in range(t)]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: The relabeling maximizes the number of starting nodes that guarantee a win for Eikooc, where a winning position is defined by optimal play from that node.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in relabeling) for relabeling in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each element in the relabeling is within the valid range of node labels.
